0.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_000
0.description: I pray this <hex:02082EE3E90C0DFF14020810E3E90C05FF04657665FF056D6F726E03FF1302080FE3E90C12FF04646179FF046576650303> finds you well, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. As caretaker of <hex:020933E802FF054D697374FF12746865204C6176656E6465722042656473FF0B74686520476F626C6574FF0A536869726F67616E6503>, it would be my pleasure to answer any queries you may have.

1.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2Q1_100_002
1.description: What would you like to ask about?

5.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A2_102_002
5.description: What kinds of plots are available?

7.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A4_104_002
7.translation_description: Come posso rinunciare a un terreno?

8.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A4_121_002
8.description: What happens if I abandon my estate?
8.translation_description: Cosa succede se abbandono la mia proprietà?

9.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CATEGORYA1_101_002
9.description: Estate hall construction and exterior customization.
9.translation_description: Costruzione della residenza e personalizzazione degli esterni.

10.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A5_105_002
10.description: How do I build an estate hall?

11.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A6_106_002
11.description: How do I customize the exterior of my estate hall?
11.translation_description: Come si personalizzano gli esterni della residenza?

12.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A7_107_002
12.description: How do I place outdoor furnishings?
12.translation_description: Come si posizionano gli arredi esterni?

14.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A8_108_002
14.description: How do I customize the interior of my estate hall?
14.translation_description: Come si personalizzano gli interni della residenza?

15.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A9_109_002
15.description: How do I place indoor furnishings?
15.translation_description: Come si posizionano gli arredi interni?

16.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A4_122_002
16.description: How do I adjust the brightness of estate lighting?
16.translation_description: Come posso regolare l'intensità delle luci della residenza?

17.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A10_110_002
17.description: Restrictions on the sale of used furnishings.
17.translation_description: Limitazioni alla vendita degli arredi usati.

18.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CATEGORYA1_103_002
18.translation_description: Funzioni delle proprietà delle compagnie libere.

19.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A12_112_002
19.description: How do I obtain private chambers?
19.translation_description: Come si ottengono le Camere Private?

20.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A13_113_002
20.description: How do I vacate private chambers?
20.translation_description: Come si lasciano le Camere Private?

21.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A13_114_002
21.description: What happens if I am dismissed from my free company?
21.translation_description: Cosa succede se vengo espulso dalla mia compagnia libera?

23.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A13_116_002
23.description: How do I demolish a company workshop?
23.translation_description: Come si demolisce un'officina della compagnia?

24.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_CHOICE2A13_117_002
24.translation_description: Cosa sono le officine delle compagnie?

36.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_011
36.description: Here, you and like-minded adventurers are free to purchase apartments, or secure plots of land on which to build estates.
36.translation_description: Qui tu e gli avventurieri con i tuoi stessi interessi potete acquistare appartamenti o assicurarvi un lotto su cui costruire una proprietà.

37.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_012
37.description: This district has been established under the auspices of the <hex:02094BE802FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF124B7567616E6520676F7665726E6D656E7403>, of course. It is their fondest hope that these favorable policies will facilitate immigration to our great nation.
37.translation_description: Questo quartiere è stato istituito sotto l'egida di <hex:02095AE802FF0C6C612054656D7065737461FF1E6C274F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF146C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF15696C20676F7665726E6F206469204B7567616E6503>, naturalmente. La loro più grande speranza è che queste politiche favorevoli incoraggino l'immigrazione nella nostra grande nazione.

38.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_013
38.description: In case you are concerned that your allegiance may bar you from residing here─do not be.
38.translation_description: Se temi che la tua affiliazione ti impedisca di vivere qui, non preoccuparti.

39.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_014
39.description: We do not concern ourselves with the private affairs of our residents. You may live here regardless of your affiliation.
39.translation_description: Non ci occupiamo delle questioni private dei residenti. Puoi vivere qui indipendentemente dalla tua affiliazione.

40.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_015
40.description: In residential districts, you may purchase <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>plots<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, on which you may construct and maintain <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>estate halls<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
40.translation_description: Nei quartieri residenziali puoi acquistare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>lotti<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> su cui costruire e mantenere <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>residenze<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

41.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_016
41.description: To ensure that there are sufficient plots for players, multiple <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>instances<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> of these districts have been created. Therefore, when entering a residential district, you will be prompted to choose the instance you wish to enter.
41.translation_description: Per garantire un numero sufficiente di lotti ai giocatori, sono state create più <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>istanze<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> di questi quartieri. Quando entri in un quartiere residenziale, ti verrà chiesto di scegliere quale visitare.

42.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_020
42.description: Some say a quality estate is built upon a quality foundation, but to them I would say, “What is a quality foundation built upon? Quality <hex:021A020203>land<hex:021A020103>, of course!”
42.translation_description: C'è chi dice che una proprietà di qualità poggi su fondamenta di qualità, ma io rispondo: «E su cosa poggiano fondamenta di qualità? Su un <hex:021A020203>terreno<hex:021A020103> di qualità, ovviamente!»

43.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_021
43.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Small<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>medium<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>large<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> plots are available for purchase in each residential district.
43.translation_description: In ogni quartiere residenziale si possono acquistare lotti <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>piccoli<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>medi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>grandi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

44.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_022
44.description: Plot size determines the maximum number of furnishings that can be placed, as well as the type of estate hall that can be constructed. <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Cottages<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be built upon small plots, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>houses<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> upon medium plots, and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>mansions<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> upon large plots.
44.translation_description: La dimensione del lotto determina il numero massimo di arredi collocabili e il tipo di residenza costruibile: sui lotti piccoli si possono costruire <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>cottage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, sui medi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>case<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e sui grandi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>tenute<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

45.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_023
45.description: Please note that the estate hall must match the plot size; a cottage <hex:021A020203>cannot<hex:021A020103> be built upon a large plot, for example.
45.translation_description: La residenza deve avere dimensioni adatte al lotto: per esempio, un cottage <hex:021A020203>non può<hex:021A020103> essere costruito su un lotto grande.

46.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_030
46.description: The process is so simple that even a child could do it─well, an exceedingly wealthy child, but I digress. First of all, the requirements for purchasing land vary depending on whether you are a private buyer, or a representative of your free company.
46.translation_description: Il procedimento è così semplice che potrebbe seguirlo anche un bambino… be', un bambino molto ricco. Ma sto divagando. Anzitutto, i requisiti per acquistare un lotto variano a seconda che tu sia un privato o il rappresentante della tua compagnia libera.

47.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_100_031
47.description: In order to purchase a plot of land privately, you must have at least one class at level 50.
47.translation_description: Per acquistare privatamente un lotto di terreno, devi avere almeno una classe al livello 50.

48.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_101_031
48.description: Furthermore, you must hold a rank of second lieutenant or above in one of the Grand Companies.
48.translation_description: Inoltre, devi essere sottotenente o superiore in una Grande Compagnia.

49.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_102_031
49.description: In order to purchase a plot of land for your free company, you must be authorized to acquire land.
49.translation_description: Per acquistare un lotto per la tua compagnia libera, devi essere autorizzato ad acquistare terreni.

50.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_103_031
50.description: In order to purchase a plot in Shirogane, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Not without Incident.”
50.translation_description: Per acquistare un lotto a Shirogane, devi prima completare l'incarico della storia principale «Non Senza Incidenti».

51.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_031
51.description: In both cases, to purchase an unowned plot, select the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>placard<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> located at its entrance and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Purchase Land<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
51.translation_description: In entrambi i casi, per acquistare un lotto libero, interagisci con la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>targa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> all'ingresso e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Acquista Terreno<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

52.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_032
52.description: The listed price will be automatically reduced every six hours until it reaches a predetermined minimum.
52.translation_description: Il prezzo indicato si riduce automaticamente ogni sei ore, fino a raggiungere il minimo prestabilito.

53.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_033
53.description: Though waiting may allow you to buy at a lower price, please keep in mind that plots are sold on a first-come-first-served basis.
53.translation_description: Attendere potrebbe consentirti di acquistare a un prezzo inferiore, ma ricorda che i lotti vengono assegnati in base all'ordine di arrivo.

54.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_040
54.description: Relinquish? <hex:021A020203>Relinquish<hex:021A020103>!? Whyever would you wish to─ <sigh> Very well, if you must know, there is a strict procedure which must be followed.
54.translation_description: Rinunciare? <hex:021A020203>Rinunciarvi<hex:021A020103>!? Perché mai vorresti farlo─ <sigh> D'accordo, se proprio vuoi saperlo, c'è una procedura precisa da seguire.

55.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_041
55.description: You cannot relinquish a plot until any private chambers have been vacated, and the estate hall and all furnishings have been removed. Once the plot is completely vacant, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Estate Settings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Finally, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Relinquish Land<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
55.translation_description: Non puoi rinunciare a un lotto finché non hai lasciato le Camere Private, rimosso la residenza e tutti gli arredi. Quando il lotto è completamente vuoto, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Impostazioni Proprietà<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Infine, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Abbandona Terreno<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

56.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_100_041
56.description: Please be warned that you will not be refunded the purchase price of the plot.
56.translation_description: Attenzione: il prezzo d'acquisto del lotto non verrà rimborsato.

57.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_100_045
57.description: To ensure that our community remains active and thriving, we have deemed it necessary to seize estates which have been left abandoned for an extended period of time.
57.translation_description: Per mantenere attiva e prospera la nostra comunità, abbiamo ritenuto necessario recuperare le proprietà rimaste abbandonate a lungo.

58.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_182
58.description: Estate halls which have not been entered by their owner for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>thirty days<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (Earth time) will be designated abandoned and scheduled for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>auto-demolition<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
58.translation_description: Le residenze non visitate dai proprietari per <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>trenta giorni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> terrestri verranno dichiarate abbandonate e programmate per la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>demolizione automatica<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

59.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_001_182
59.description: Once the estate hall has not been entered for a total of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>forty-five days<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (Earth time), it will be demolished, and the plot will be put up for sale.
59.translation_description: Se la residenza non viene visitata per un totale di <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>quarantacinque giorni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> terrestri, verrà demolita e il lotto sarà messo in vendita.

60.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_183
60.description: All members of a free company are considered owners of a company estate.
60.translation_description: Tutti i membri di una compagnia libera sono considerati comproprietari della proprietà.

61.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_001_183
61.description: However, private estates may only have a single recognized owner.
61.translation_description: Una proprietà privata, invece, può avere un solo proprietario riconosciuto.

62.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_184
62.description: Therefore, while any member of a free company may enter a company estate hall to prevent auto-demolition, the only individual who can prevent the auto-demolition of a private estate is its owner.
62.translation_description: Di conseguenza, qualsiasi membro di una compagnia libera può entrare nella proprietà della compagnia per impedirne la demolizione automatica, ma solo il proprietario può farlo per una proprietà privata.

63.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_185
63.description: In the event your estate is demolished and your plot is sold, you will be able to claim indemnification for 80% of the plot's value. Furthermore, furnishings which can be safely removed will be stored for safekeeping by the resident caretaker.
63.translation_description: Se la tua proprietà viene demolita e il lotto venduto, potrai richiedere un indennizzo pari all'80% del valore del lotto. Inoltre, gli arredi che possono essere rimossi senza danni verranno custoditi dal Custode Residenziale.

64.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_186
64.description: However, please be advised that you will only be able to claim items and indemnification from the resident caretaker within <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>thirty-five days<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (Earth time) following the demolition of your estate hall.
64.translation_description: Tuttavia, potrai ritirare gli oggetti e l'indennizzo dal Custode Residenziale solo entro <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>trentacinque giorni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> terrestri dalla demolizione della residenza.

65.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_187
65.description: Only free company members who have been granted the authority to purchase and relinquish land for the free company may claim items and indemnification for company estates.
65.translation_description: Solo i membri della compagnia libera autorizzati ad acquistare e abbandonare terreni per conto della compagnia possono ritirare gli oggetti e l'indennizzo relativi alla proprietà della compagnia.

66.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_188
66.description: However, only the former owner of a private estate may claim items and indemnification.
66.translation_description: Per una proprietà privata, solo l'ex proprietario può ritirare gli oggetti e l'indennizzo.

67.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_050
67.description: A new home, full of hope and promise... The mere thought of it warms the cockles of my heart. Do understand, though, that there are certain regulations that must be observed before construction can proceed.
67.translation_description: Una nuova casa, piena di speranze e promesse… Al solo pensiero mi si scalda il cuore. Ma sappi che, prima di iniziare a costruire, occorre rispettare alcune regole.

68.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_051
68.description: All residents must first obtain a valid building permit─one which applies to their plot's exact specifications.
68.translation_description: Ogni residente deve prima ottenere un permesso di costruzione valido e conforme alle caratteristiche specifiche del proprio lotto.

69.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_052
69.description: Some find these restrictions arbitrary, but we feel them necessary to ensure proper land usage. Oh, and do bear in mind that permits are only valid in a given region─we will not recognize one issued by another city<hex:021F0103>state.
69.translation_description: Alcuni considerano queste restrizioni arbitrarie, ma le riteniamo necessarie per usare correttamente il terreno. Inoltre, ricorda che i permessi sono validi solo nella regione in cui sono stati emessi: non riconosciamo quelli rilasciati da un'altra città-stato.

70.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_053
70.description: To build an estate hall, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while on your property, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Estate Hall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Build Estate Hall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, then choose a valid permit from the list.
70.translation_description: Per costruire una residenza, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mentre ti trovi sul tuo lotto, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Residenza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Costruisci Residenza<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e scegli un permesso valido dall'elenco.

71.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_060
71.description: Rare is the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> satisfied with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> abode. Fortunately, there are innumerable ways in which one might remodel their estate hall.
71.translation_description: È raro che <hex:020817E905FF0A756E6120646F6E6E61FF08756E20756F6D6F03> si senta a proprio agio nella <hex:020815E905FF0870726F70726961FF0870726F7072696103> dimora. Per fortuna, ci sono innumerevoli modi per ristrutturare la propria residenza.

72.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_061
72.description: You can customize the roof, roof decorations, exterior walls, exterior wall decorations, windows, door, placard, and fence of your estate.
72.translation_description: Puoi personalizzare il tetto, le decorazioni del tetto, le pareti esterne, le decorazioni delle pareti, le finestre, la porta, la targa e la recinzione della tua proprietà.

73.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_062
73.description: To change any of these elements, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while on your property but outside your estate hall, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Remodel Exterior<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
73.translation_description: Per modificare questi elementi, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sul tuo lotto, ma all'esterno della residenza, e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ristruttura Esterni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

74.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_063
74.description: Please note that, once confirmed, all changes are permanent. Items used for remodeling cannot be retrieved, as replaced elements will be discarded.
74.translation_description: Una volta confermate, tutte le modifiche sono permanenti. Gli elementi usati per ristrutturare non possono essere recuperati: quelli sostituiti verranno eliminati.

75.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_070
75.description: Interested in flaunting your wealth, are you? Say no more, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.
75.translation_description: Vuoi ostentare la tua ricchezza? Non aggiungo altro, <hex:020815E905FF085369676E6F7261FF085369676E6F726503>.

76.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_071
76.description: Accentuating your estate with tasteful furnishings demonstrates culture and influence─both of which you have in abundance, I am certain.
76.translation_description: Arredare la tua proprietà con gusto dimostra cultura e prestigio: qualità che sicuramente non ti mancano.

77.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_072
77.description: To place outdoor furnishings, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while on your property but outside your estate hall, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Outdoor Furnishings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
77.translation_description: Per posizionare gli arredi esterni, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sul tuo lotto, ma all'esterno della residenza, e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Arredi per Esterni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

78.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_080
78.description: Home is indeed where the heart is, which is why creating a space which reflects your individuality is so very important.
78.translation_description: È a casa che si trova il cuore; per questo è così importante creare un ambiente che rifletta la tua personalità.

79.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_081
79.description: You can customize the interior walls, flooring, and ceiling lights of your estate hall.
79.translation_description: Puoi personalizzare le pareti interne, il pavimento e le luci del soffitto della tua residenza.

80.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_082
80.description: To change any of these elements, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while inside your estate hall, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Remodel Interior<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
80.translation_description: Per modificare questi elementi, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> all'interno della residenza e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ristruttura Interni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

81.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_083
81.description: Please note that, once confirmed, all changes are permanent. Items used for remodeling cannot be retrieved, as replaced elements will be discarded.
81.translation_description: Una volta confermate, tutte le modifiche sono permanenti. Gli elementi usati per ristrutturare non possono essere recuperati: quelli sostituiti verranno eliminati.

82.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_090
82.description: Veritable treatises have been written on the subject of interior decoration. I will not profess to be an expert, but, if you will allow, I should be glad to share with you what I know.
82.translation_description: Sull'arredamento degli interni sono stati scritti veri e propri trattati. Non pretendo di essere competente in materia, ma, se vuoi, condividerò volentieri ciò che so.

83.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_091
83.description: To place indoor furnishings, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while inside your estate hall, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Indoor Furnishings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
83.translation_description: Per posizionare gli arredi interni, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> all'interno della residenza e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Arredi Interni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

84.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_092
84.description: Please note that the locations where you may place a furnishing are dictated by its type.
84.translation_description: La possibilità di posizionare un arredo dipende dalla sua tipologia.

85.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_095
85.description: Well, I...I would have thought it a rather simple affair, but if you require an explanation...
85.translation_description: Beh, io… avrei pensato che fosse una cosa piuttosto semplice, ma se ti serve una spiegazione…

86.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_191
86.description: To adjust the brightness of your estate hall or private chambers' lighting, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while inside and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Interior Settings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
86.translation_description: Per regolare l'intensità delle luci della residenza o delle Camere Private, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> mentre ti trovi all'interno e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Impostazioni Interni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

87.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_192
87.description: You may select one of six different brightness levels. However, please note that certain furnishings will not be affected.
87.translation_description: Puoi scegliere fra sei livelli di luminosità. Alcuni arredi, tuttavia, non ne saranno influenzati.

88.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_100
88.description: Placing a furnishing will <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>bind<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> it to you, preventing future trade or sale to other players.
88.translation_description: Quando posizioni un arredo, questo viene <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>vincolato<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> al tuo personaggio, impedendoti di scambiarlo o venderlo ad altri giocatori.

89.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_101
89.description: Moreover, certain furnishings cannot be retrieved once placed, and will be permanently discarded upon removal.
89.translation_description: Alcuni arredi non possono essere recuperati una volta posizionati e verranno eliminati definitivamente quando li rimuovi.

90.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_102
90.description: You will be prompted to confirm your decision before removing these furnishings.
90.translation_description: Prima di rimuovere questi arredi ti verrà chiesto di confermare la scelta.

91.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_110
91.description: For a nominal fee, you can purchase your very own private chambers, which will be added to your free company's estate.
91.translation_description: Con una spesa modesta, puoi acquistare Camere Private tutte tue, da aggiungere alla proprietà della tua compagnia libera.

92.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_111
92.description: Private chambers can be purchased and accessed from within your free company's estate.
92.translation_description: Puoi acquistare e raggiungere le Camere Private dall'interno della proprietà della tua compagnia libera.

93.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_112
93.description: Please note that you cannot purchase private chambers until you have attained level 50 in a single class.
93.translation_description: Per acquistare Camere Private devi aver raggiunto il livello 50 in una singola classe.

94.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_113
94.description: Moreover, you must also have attained the rank of second lieutenant in the Maelstrom, the Order of the Twin Adder, or the Immortal Flames.
94.translation_description: Inoltre, devi aver raggiunto il grado di sottotenente nella Tempesta, nell'Ordine della Vipera Gemella o nelle Fiamme Immortali.

95.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_120
95.description: If you no longer require the privacy afforded by private chambers, you may choose to vacate them─provided you follow the necessary procedures.
95.translation_description: Se non hai più bisogno della privacy offerta dalle Camere Private, puoi rinunciarvi, a patto di seguire la procedura prevista.

96.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_121
96.description: In order to vacate your private chambers, you must first remove all furnishings.
96.translation_description: Per lasciare le Camere Private, devi prima rimuovere tutti gli arredi.

97.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_122
97.description: Once your private chambers are completely empty, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while on your property, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Estate Settings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Private Chambers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and then select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Vacate Chambers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
97.translation_description: Quando le Camere Private saranno completamente vuote, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sul tuo lotto, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Impostazioni Proprietà<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Camere Private<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e infine <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Lascia Camera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

98.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_130
98.description: Should you be forced to part ways with your free company due to irreconcilable differences, you will no longer be able to avail yourself of your private chambers.
98.translation_description: Se dovessi lasciare la tua compagnia libera a causa di divergenze insanabili, non potrai più usufruire delle Camere Private.

99.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_131
99.description: Any furnishings in your chambers will be collected for safekeeping. However, please be advised that this service is only provided for a limited time.
99.translation_description: Gli arredi presenti nelle Camere Private verranno ritirati e custoditi. Questo servizio è disponibile solo per un periodo limitato.

100.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_132
100.description: If you are dismissed from your free company, your private chambers will be demolished, and furnishings placed in your private chambers will be given into the care of the resident caretaker.
100.translation_description: Se vieni espulso dalla compagnia libera, le Camere Private verranno demolite e gli arredi al loro interno saranno affidati al Custode Residenziale.

101.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_133
101.description: Furnishings will be held by the resident caretaker for 35 days (Earth time), after which they will be permanently discarded.
101.translation_description: Il Custode Residenziale terrà gli arredi per 35 giorni terrestri, dopodiché verranno eliminati definitivamente.

102.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_134
102.description: The time remaining until your furnishings are discarded can be confirmed by selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> located under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>main menu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
102.translation_description: Puoi controllare quanto manca all'eliminazione degli arredi selezionando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sotto <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> nel <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>menu principale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

103.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_135
103.description: Please be advised that certain furnishings as well as all interior fixtures will not be given into the care of resident caretakers, and you will not be refunded any gil used to purchase your private chambers.
103.translation_description: Alcuni arredi e tutti gli elementi interni non verranno affidati ai custodi residenziali; inoltre, non ti saranno restituiti i gil spesi per acquistare le Camere Private.

104.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_140
104.description: If you are a member of a free company, then I presume you are aware of the benefits provided by company actions. Aetherial wheels are another means by which one may acquire said actions.
104.translation_description: Se fai parte di una compagnia libera, conoscerai già i vantaggi offerti dalle azioni di compagnia. Le ruote eteree sono un altro modo per ottenerle.

105.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_141
105.description: However, before you can make use of aetherial wheels, you must first procure a suitable stand for your estate.
105.translation_description: Prima di poter usare una ruota eterea, devi procurarti un supporto adatto per la tua proprietà.

106.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_142
106.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Aetherial wheels<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be used to acquire company actions without the use of company credits. The aetherial wheel stands required to do so can be obtained from housing merchants in any residential district.
106.translation_description: Le <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ruote Eteree<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> permettono di ottenere azioni di compagnia senza spendere crediti della compagnia. I supporti necessari si possono acquistare dai mercanti degli alloggi in ogni quartiere residenziale.

107.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_143
107.description: To charge an aetherial wheel, simply place it in a stand, and it will gradually accumulate aether over a period of time.
107.translation_description: Per caricare una ruota eterea, basta posizionarla su un supporto: accumulerà etere gradualmente nel tempo.

108.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_144
108.description: Once primed, you may remove the aetherial wheel and use the stand to convert it into a company action, or you may choose to store it until a later date.
108.translation_description: Quando è carica, puoi rimuovere la ruota eterea e usare il supporto per convertirla in un'azione di compagnia, oppure conservarla per dopo.

109.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_150
109.description: Residents are more than welcome to employ their retainers as merchants on their estate grounds─provided they obtain the necessary documentation in advance.
109.translation_description: I residenti possono impiegare i propri servitori come mercanti nei terreni della proprietà, purché ottengano in anticipo i permessi necessari.

110.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_151
110.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Expansion of duties permits<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which can be purchased from independent sutlers in any residential district, can be used to place a retainer on your estate grounds outside the hall.
110.translation_description: I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>permessi di estensione degli incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, acquistabili dai mercanti indipendenti di ogni quartiere residenziale, permettono di collocare un servitore nei terreni della proprietà, all'esterno della residenza.

111.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_152
111.description: Items currently placed on the market by your retainer can then be purchased by anyone who speaks with them.
111.translation_description: Chiunque parli con il servitore potrà acquistare gli oggetti che ha messo in vendita.

112.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_153
112.description: When using a permit, you will be prompted to select a retainer to place. However, should you wish to change retainers afterwards, you may do so freely.
112.translation_description: Quando utilizzi un permesso, ti verrà chiesto quale servitore collocare. Se in seguito vorrai sostituirlo, potrai farlo liberamente.

113.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_154
113.description: If you are placing a retainer on a free company estate, please be advised that, in the event you leave or are discharged from your free company, your retainer will not be automatically removed.
113.translation_description: Se collochi un servitore nella proprietà di una compagnia libera, sappi che non verrà rimosso automaticamente se lasci la compagnia o vieni espulso.

114.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_155
114.description: Once placed on a free company estate, retainers can only be removed by members who have the authority to do so.
114.translation_description: I servitori collocati nella proprietà di una compagnia libera possono essere rimossi solo dai membri autorizzati a farlo.

115.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_155
115.description: For quite some time, many of our residents have expressed a desire to formally share their estates with other individuals. After due consideration, we have enacted a new system to facilitate such arrangements.
115.translation_description: Da tempo molti residenti chiedono di poter condividere formalmente la propria proprietà con altre persone. Dopo un'attenta valutazione, abbiamo istituito un nuovo sistema per agevolare queste disposizioni.

116.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_201
116.description: If you are the owner of a private estate, you may choose to share it with up to three friends, regardless of plot size.
116.translation_description: Se possiedi una proprietà privata, puoi condividerla con un massimo di tre amici, a prescindere dalle dimensioni del lotto.

117.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_202
117.description: To welcome friends as tenants, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Private Estate<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, then select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Shared Estate Settings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>New Tenant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
117.translation_description: Per accogliere gli amici come inquilini, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Proprietà Privata<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Impostazioni Residenza Condivisa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e infine <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Nuovo Inquilino<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

118.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_203
118.description: You may then grant these friends─or tenants─access to certain estate features, such as gardening, stable tending, and estate customization.
118.translation_description: Potrai poi consentire a questi amici—o inquilini—di accedere ad alcune funzioni della proprietà, come il giardinaggio, la cura delle stalle dei chocobo e la personalizzazione degli esterni.

119.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_204
119.description: To grant or revoke authorizations, select a tenant, then select or deselect estate features as you see fit.
119.translation_description: Per concedere o revocare le autorizzazioni, seleziona un inquilino e attiva o disattiva le funzioni della proprietà che desideri.

120.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_205
120.description: Furthermore, you may evict tenants at any time by selecting their name, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Evict<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
120.translation_description: Puoi inoltre sfrattare gli inquilini quando vuoi selezionandone il nome e poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Sfratta<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

121.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_170
121.description: Should you and your fellow free company members have a mind to engage in more creative pursuits, you may consider purchasing a company workshop.
121.translation_description: Se tu e gli altri membri della compagnia libera desiderate dedicarvi ad attività più creative, potete acquistare un'officina della compagnia.

122.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_171
122.description: These workshops are furnished with facilities for constructing airships, which can then be deployed on exploratory voyages into the Sea of Clouds.
122.translation_description: Le officine dispongono di strutture per costruire aeronavi, che possono poi essere inviate in esplorazione nel Mar di Nuvole.

123.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_172
123.description: It's all rather popular these days, I'm told. However, I should warn you that it is also quite demanding. Without the cooperation of your fellow free company members, you may struggle to make progress.
123.translation_description: A quanto mi dicono, è molto in voga. Ti avviso però che richiede parecchio impegno. Senza la collaborazione degli altri membri della compagnia, potresti faticare a fare progressi.

124.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_173
124.description: A <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>company workshop<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be purchased from within your free company's estate.
124.translation_description: Un'<hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>officina della compagnia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> può essere acquistata all'interno della proprietà della tua compagnia libera.

125.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_174
125.description: After construction, it can be accessed in the same manner as private chambers.
125.translation_description: Una volta costruita, puoi accedervi come faresti con le Camere Private.

126.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_175
126.description: To learn more about the company workshop's facilities, speak with the mammet voyager #004A included with your purchase.
126.translation_description: Per conoscere le funzioni dell'officina della compagnia, parla con il mammet viaggiatore #004A incluso nell'acquisto.

127.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_160
127.description: D-Demolish a workshop!? I suppose you <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> do so, if you truly had no more use for it...
127.translation_description: D-Demolire un'officina!? Immagino che <hex:021A020203>potresti<hex:021A020103> farlo, se davvero non ti servisse più…

128.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_161
128.description: <hex:021A020203>Should<hex:021A020103> you do so, however, any time and gil spent will be for naught, as all records of your activities will be expunged.
128.translation_description: <hex:021A020203>Se<hex:021A020103> lo facessi, però, tutto il tempo e i gil spesi sarebbero inutili, perché ogni dato relativo alla tua attività verrebbe cancellato.

129.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_162
129.description: To demolish your company workshop, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Housing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu while on your property, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Estate Settings<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Free Company Estate<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and then select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Demolish Workshop<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
129.translation_description: Per demolire la tua officina, apri il menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Alloggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> sul tuo lotto, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Impostazioni Proprietà<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Proprietà di Compagnia Libera<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e infine <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Demolisci Officina<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

130.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_163
130.description: Please note that before you can demolish your company workshop, you must first complete or discontinue any projects in progress, as well as dismantle any airships currently in service.
130.translation_description: Prima di demolire l'officina, devi completare o annullare tutti i progetti in corso e smantellare tutte le aeronavi attualmente in servizio.

131.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_164
131.description: Moreover, please be advised that by choosing to demolish the company workshop, you will lose any progression made in company projects and exploratory voyages, and will not be refunded any gil used to purchase the facilities.
131.translation_description: Tieni presente che, demolendo l'officina della compagnia, perderai tutti i progressi dei progetti e dei viaggi esplorativi, e non ti verranno restituiti i gil spesi per acquistare le strutture.

132.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_156
132.description: Apartments are cozy, one-room properties developed for the use of individual adventurers. Not everyone who moves to our residential district wishes to live in some sprawling estate!
132.translation_description: Gli appartamenti sono alloggi accoglienti di una sola stanza, pensati per i singoli avventurieri. Non tutti quelli che si trasferiscono nel nostro quartiere residenziale vogliono vivere in una tenuta sconfinata!

133.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_157
133.description: The Topmast, Lily Hills, Sultana's Breath, and Kobai Goten apartment buildings are found in the residential districts of Mist, the Lavender Beds, the Goblet, and Shirogane respectively.
133.translation_description: I condomini Il Topmast, Colline dei Gigli, Il Respiro della Sultana e Kobai Goten si trovano rispettivamente nei quartieri residenziali della Bruma, delle Aiuole di Lavanda, del Calice e di Shirogane.

134.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_158
134.description: For more information on apartment prices and features, speak with the apartment caretakers stationed in the lobbies of the aforementioned buildings.
134.translation_description: Per informazioni sui prezzi e sulle caratteristiche degli appartamenti, parla con i custodi che si trovano negli atri dei suddetti edifici.

135.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_210
135.description: What!? You wish to take your <hex:021A020203>entire<hex:021A020103> estate hall and <hex:021A020203>move<hex:021A020103> it to another location!? ...Actually, that is perfectly possible.
135.translation_description: Cosa!? Vuoi trasferire <hex:021A020203>per intero<hex:021A020103> la tua residenza e <hex:021A020203>spostarla<hex:021A020103> altrove!? …In effetti è assolutamente possibile.

136.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_211
136.description: It is possible to relocate your estate hall to a new plot. The destination plot can be situated in any residential area and be of any size.
136.translation_description: Puoi trasferire la tua residenza su un nuovo lotto, situato in qualsiasi quartiere residenziale e di qualunque dimensione.

137.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_212
137.description: Private estates may be relocated by their owners at will, while free company estates require those with authority to purchase and relinquish land.
137.translation_description: Le proprietà private possono essere trasferite dai rispettivi proprietari in qualsiasi momento; per quelle delle compagnie libere, invece, serve l'autorizzazione ad acquistare e abbandonare terreni.

138.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_213
138.description: To begin the process, inspect the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>placard<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> located at the entrance of the destination plot and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Purchase Land<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. A prompt for relocation will appear.
138.translation_description: Per iniziare, esamina la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>targa<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> all'ingresso del lotto di destinazione e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Acquista Terreno<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Comparirà un'opzione per il trasferimento.

139.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_214
139.description: When making the purchase, 30% of the minimum value of the old plot will be applied towards the price of the new.
139.translation_description: Al momento dell'acquisto, il 30% del valore minimo del vecchio lotto verrà scalato dal prezzo del nuovo.

140.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_221
140.description: Upon relocation, placed furnishings will be put in the storeroom at the destination plot, save for the chocobo stables and the miniature aetheryte, which will be placed in the garden.
140.translation_description: Dopo il trasferimento, gli arredi collocati verranno spostati nel magazzino del lotto di destinazione, tranne le stalle dei chocobo e l'etereite in miniatura, che saranno collocate in giardino.

141.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_222
141.description: Private chambers and company workshops will be moved in their entirety and retain their state.
141.translation_description: Le Camere Private e le officine della compagnia verranno trasferite per intero e manterranno il loro stato.

142.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_224
142.description: Exterior fixtures will be altered to match the new residential area and plot size, in the event that they are different.
142.translation_description: Se necessario, le finiture esterne verranno adattate al nuovo quartiere residenziale e alle dimensioni del lotto.

143.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_225
143.description: Interior fixtures, meanwhile, will remain intact, unless the relocation results in an estate hall with fewer floors. In this case, the fixtures will be lost alongside the floor.
143.translation_description: Gli elementi interni, invece, resteranno intatti, a meno che il trasferimento non comporti una residenza con meno piani. In tal caso, gli elementi del piano rimosso andranno perduti.

144.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_231
144.description: Estate halls which have not been entered by their owner for thirty days (Earth time) cannot be relocated.
144.translation_description: Le residenze non visitate dai proprietari per trenta giorni terrestri non possono essere trasferite.

145.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_232
145.description: Furthermore, initiating a relocation has the same effect as the owner entering his or her estate hall, and resets the period until auto-demolition.
145.translation_description: Inoltre, avviare un trasferimento equivale a una visita del proprietario alla residenza e azzera il conto alla rovescia per la demolizione automatica.

146.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_HOUSINGOFFICER_000_240
146.description: From fully fledged estate halls to cozy apartments, all types of housing come with a storeroom for keeping one's furnishings. The larger the residence, the bigger the storeroom.
146.translation_description: Dalle residenze complete agli accoglienti appartamenti, ogni tipo di abitazione dispone di un magazzino per riporre gli arredi. Più grande è l'alloggio, più capiente è il magazzino.

147.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_241
147.description: Cottages have storage for 200 indoor and 20 garden furnishings. This increases to 300 and 30 for houses, and 400 and 40 for mansions.
147.translation_description: I cottage possono contenere 200 arredi interni e 20 da giardino. Per le case il limite sale a 300 e 30, e per le tenute a 400 e 40.

148.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_242
148.description: Apartments, meanwhile, have storage for 100 indoor furnishings.
148.translation_description: Gli appartamenti, invece, possono contenere 100 arredi interni.

149.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_243
149.description: Please note that chocobo stables and miniature aetherytes alone cannot be stored.
149.translation_description: Solo le stalle dei chocobo e le etereiti in miniatura non possono essere riposte.

150.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_244
150.description: Certain items, meanwhile, are stored in stasis. For instance, plants will cease to grow and wheel stands will cease to charge.
150.translation_description: Alcuni oggetti vengono conservati in stasi. Per esempio, le piante smettono di crescere e i supporti per le ruote eteree smettono di caricarsi.

151.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_245
151.description: Upon relocation, placed furnishings will be put in the storeroom at the destination plot. If there is insufficient space, however, the relocation cannot proceed.
151.translation_description: Dopo il trasferimento, gli arredi collocati verranno spostati nel magazzino del lotto di destinazione. Se lo spazio non è sufficiente, tuttavia, il trasferimento non potrà essere completato.

152.name: TEXT_COMDEFHOUSINGOFFICER_00136_SYSTEM_000_246
152.description: An estate hall cannot be removed while items are in storage. In the event that your estate hall is demolished, you may reclaim stored items by speaking with the resident caretaker within 35 days of repossession.
152.translation_description: Non puoi rimuovere una residenza finché ci sono oggetti nel magazzino. Se la residenza viene demolita, potrai ritirare gli oggetti custoditi parlando con il Custode Residenziale entro 35 giorni terrestri dalla demolizione.
